scope: Only original immutable static_000.json through static_040.json, 41 initialization attempts; no resumed files or whole297 extrapolation
threshold_rule: All six finite values <= threshold. roundtrip max absolute full50-state error divided by .1; history/future grid comparisons use mass-relative theta plus full omega, flattened and divided by STATE_SCALE=.1.

definitions.stage1: simple up to600 actual historical residual calls; requires best point and converged or budget_limited, then numerical qualification
definitions.stage2: smooth up to1200 actual historical residual calls only if stage1 numerical qualification passes; selected returned point must pass final numerical qualification
definitions.history_fit: best.history_mse/RMS measures predicted history versus observed11 points, using per-machine configured theta/omega scales. It is not main-vs-fine discretization error.
definitions.numerical_history: Backward .1s histories using .0025/.00125s compared at common observation times.
definitions.numerical_future: Recorded qualification only: autonomous1s at .01/.005s compared at common times; this extraction reads recorded scalar errors and performs no integration or future prediction assessment.
definitions.failure_meaning: blocked_by_stage1 denotes unavailable numerical-qualified stage1 output; it is not a history-fit-error threshold, actual physical instability, or L1 classification.
definitions.optimizer: budget_limited may still supply eligible best point. scipy_success and KKT can be null; optimization_sufficiency stays unknown. optimizer KKT and observation KKT differ by divisor squared and must remain distinct.
